title: Five Sizes of When
label: ch:anoche-y-todavia
canDo: I can say last night, the week, early, right away and still in Spanish, and say why an -o on the end of temprano never becomes an -a.

payoff.summary: Complete ES-C322-todavia: place a thing at anoche, count in semanas, arrive temprano, answer enseguida, and say todavia no.
